question: The value of 14 + [100 ÷ {60 ÷ (18 ÷ 6)}] of 400 is :
solution:
**Concept used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/110d90086aa645608f502df74313cf25db2f80582ef3dbbd4265567e363ec2ab.png] 

**Calculation:**

14 + [100 ÷ {60 ÷ (18 ÷ 6)}] of 400

⇒ 14 + [100 ÷ {60 ÷ 3}] of 400

⇒ 14 + [100 ÷ 20] of 400

⇒ 14 + 5 of 400

⇒ 14 + 2000

⇒ 2014

**∴ The correct answer is 2014.**
